title: CI will fail at 'Audit dependencies': composer audit reports a new advisory against the installed laravel/framework v12.69.3 (blocks Tests, and so the deploy)
evidence: .github/workflows/tests.yml:50-51: `- name: Audit dependencies` / `run: composer audit`. server/composer.lock:1285-1286: `"name": "laravel/framework", "version": "v12.69.3"`. Running `cd server && composer audit` today exits 1: `Found 1 security vulnerability advisory affecting 1 package: laravel/framework | Severity low | CVE-2026-128083 | Laravel: Task Output Injection - Concurrency Process | https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-63hm-g96r-2m2q | Affected versions >=13.0.0,<13.40.0|<12.71.0 | Reported at 2026-11-13T18:54:31+00:00`. composer.lock is not part of today's diff, so nobody's local run of the suite shows it.
impact: Not caused by today's code, but it decides whether today's work can ship: the advisory was published on 2026-11-13, so the next push runs `composer audit`, the step exits 1, the Laravel job is red, Tests is red, and the Deploy workflow (which runs only after Tests passed) does not start. Every other CI step I could reproduce is green on the current tree (see the summary).
fix: In server/: `composer update laravel/framework --with-all-dependencies` (a dry run resolves to v12.72.0, which is outside the affected range, plus small bumps of guzzle, laravel/prompts, serializable-closure, cron-expression and doctrine/inflector). Then `composer audit` (must exit 0), `vendor/bin/pint --test`, `php artisan test`, and commit composer.lock. If the upgrade cannot be taken today, add to the `config` block of server/composer.json `"audit": {"ignore": {"GHSA-63hm-g96r-2m2q": "Concurrency facade is not used (no reference in app, config or routes)"}}` and schedule the upgrade; the app has no use of Illuminate\Support\Facades\Concurrency.

title: SAO Grievances: the three queue tiles always show 0, because the page asks for status=submitted,under_review and the API rejects that format with 422
evidence: Client (today's change), lines 19 and 76-80: `const OPEN_STATUSES = TILE_STATUSES.join(',');` ... `...TILE_URGENCIES.map((value) => getGrievances({ urgency: value, status: OPEN_STATUSES, per_page: 1 })...` inside one `Promise.all([...]).then(...).catch(() => setCounts(EMPTY_COUNTS))`. Server, GrievanceController::index: `'status' => ['nullable', FilterValues::rule(['nullable', 'in:submitted,under_review,resolved,dismissed'])]`, and App\Support\FilterValues::values() accepts only one value or a JSON list (`if (is_string($value) && str_starts_with($value, '['))`), never a comma list. Verified against the seeded MySQL database as the SAO: `GET /api/grievances?urgency=Critical&status=submitted,under_review&per_page=1` -> `422 {"message":"The selected status filter is invalid."}` (same with %2C); `status=["submitted","under_review"]` -> 200. The unit test pins the broken format with a mocked service (SaoGrievancesPage.test.jsx:99 and :140: `toHaveBeenCalledWith({ urgency: 'Critical', status: 'submitted,under_review', per_page: 1 })`), so it passes.
impact: Regression from today's grievance fix, between the client change and the server filter helper. On every load of /dashboard/super-admin/grievances, and after every status change, correction or delete, the Critical request fails, Promise.all rejects, and the catch resets all three tiles (Submitted, Under review, Critical) to 0. The SAO is told there are no new, in-progress or critical grievances while the table below lists them; the tiles exist to show the queue that needs a person. The browser console also logs a 422 on each load.
fix: Send the list in the format the API accepts: `const OPEN_STATUSES = JSON.stringify(TILE_STATUSES);` (gives `["submitted","under_review"]`). Update the two expectations in SaoGrievancesPage.test.jsx (lines 99 and 140) to that string. Add a server test in GrievanceAiAuditFixesTest that calls `/api/grievances?urgency=Critical&status=["submitted","under_review"]&per_page=1` as the SAO and asserts `total` counts only open Critical grievances, so the contract is tested without a mock. Optionally make loadCounts resilient with Promise.allSettled so one failed count cannot zero the other two.

title: End-to-end spec with a fixed task deadline of 2026-11-30 turns the e2e job red from 1 December (existing spec, not changed today)
evidence: `const taskResponse = await request.post(`${apiUrl}/tasks`, { headers: bearer(admin.token), data: { title: taskTitle, deadline: '2026-11-30', status: 'pending', assigned_to: 900005, ... } });` followed by `expect([200, 201]).toContain(taskResponse.status());`. TaskController::rules() (line 428): `'deadline' => $partial ? [...] : ['required', 'date', 'after_or_equal:today']`. Verified on the seeded stack: POST /api/tasks with a past date -> `422 {"message":"Deadline must be on or after today."}`.
impact: Today is 2026-11-14. From 2026-12-01 Manila time (2026-11-30 16:00 UTC) the create call answers 422, 'Step 13' of hierarchy-live fails, the End-to-end job is red and deploys stop until someone edits the spec. This is the same class of failure as release 1109 in CLAUDE.md (one stale spec hides everything after it). Every other e2e spec I read builds its dates from Date.now().
fix: Replace the literal with a computed date, as officer.spec.js does: `const deadline = new Date(Date.now() + 14 * 24 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);` and send `deadline`. No app change.

title: Dashboard forecast suggestion still speaks from whichever forecast row was written last, even for a period long past, while budget advice now ignores such rows
evidence: forecastTrend(): `$forecast = DB::table('financial_forecasts')->where('organization_id', $organizationId)->orderByDesc('updated_at')->orderByDesc('id')->first();` then `$title = match ($risk) { 'overspending' => "Spending may outpace income in {$period}", ... default => "Spending looks on track for {$period}" }`. Today's finance fix added the opposite rule for advice, BudgetController::currentForecast(): `/** The generated forecast for this month or next; a manual row, an older month or free text never drives advice. */`. Verified on the seeded database as the PSITS Admin (November 2026, no forecast generated this month): GET /api/dashboard/briefing returns the insight `'Spending looks on track for Q1 2025 (Jan-Mar)'`. EventController line 216 (`FinancialForecast::latestFor(...)`, the event's financial summary) picks the row the same way.
impact: An Admin or Officer whose organization last generated a forecast months ago (or has only an old or manually entered row) sees 'Suggestions from your records' state, in the future tense, a verdict about a month or quarter that is over, on the dashboard and in the event details, while the Budgets page on the same day says no current forecast is available. Two areas fixed today now disagree about which forecast counts.
fix: Give the model one method for this, for example `FinancialForecast::currentFor(int $organizationId): ?self` holding the query now private in BudgetController::currentForecast() (period is this month or next, engine python-fastapi or php-fallback), and use it in BudgetController, DashboardInsightEngine::forecastTrend() and the event financial summary in EventController (line 216); return no forecast insight when it is null. Add a DashboardInsightAuditFixesTest case: a forecast whose forecast_period is two months old produces no financial_forecast insight.

title: Documentation left wrong by today's changes (announcement draft fallback, student navigation, data dictionary, forecast access)
evidence: (1) docs/manage-announcements-use-case.md:26: 'sends only supplied title/audience/category/details to Groq, records structured context and output, and returns a retryable error instead of placeholder copy when Groq fails.' The endpoint returns 200 with a template (`'is_template' => $isTemplate`, `'notice' => ... templateNotice(...)`), verified: with no provider the response is `{"output_text":"General assembly: please read the details below....","model_name":"template-draft","is_template":true,...}`. (2) docs/UX_FLOW.md:274: '**STUDENT** (7 rows, 11 leaves; same size, renamed and reordered)' while navigation.test.js now asserts `['STUDENT', 8, 13]` and the list under it has no Ask AI row. (3) docs/MEMBER_TESTING.md:105: 'Student: Dashboard, Ask AI; My payments (Statement of account, Receipts); ...' has no 'Where your fees go'. (4) docs/DATA_DICTIONARY.md (hand-updated on 2026-11-13 for the election migrations), docs/data-dictionary.csv and docs/data-dictionary-compact.txt have no ai_conversations, ai_messages or ai_memories tables and no grievances.machine_urgency, machine_category, classification_corrected_by, classification_corrected_at (migrations 2026_11_14_000001 and 000002). (5) docs/generate-financial-forecasts-budget-advice-use-case.md:18: 'Only Admin can access financial insights and forecast APIs.' but routes/api.php:317 gives GET /forecasts to `role:ADMIN,SBO_OFFICER,DEPARTMENT_HEAD` and FinancePage now groups forecasts per organization for a Department Head.
impact: The next person to work from these documents (QA using MEMBER_TESTING, the paper's data dictionary, an engineer reading the use cases) gets a wrong picture of the endpoint, the student menu and the schema. No runtime effect.
fix: (1) Rewrite line 26: 'sends the supplied title, audience, category and details (at most 2,000 characters) to the configured writer (Claude first, Groq as fallback); when no writer answers, or the draft is empty or adds a date, time or number the officer did not give, it returns a template draft marked is_template with a notice. A draft slot is reserved against the daily limit before the call.' (2) Change the heading to '(8 rows, 13 leaves)' and add '- Ask AI `/dashboard/ask-ai`' after Dashboard. (3) 'My payments (Statement of account, Receipts, Where your fees go)'. (4) Add the three tables under 'AI and audit' and the four columns under 'grievances' in all three dictionary files, and extend the header note with today's date. (5) 'Only the Admin generates, enters and deletes forecasts and asks for budget advice; the Officer and the Department Head read forecasts.'

title: FinancePage adds a second date formatter (dayLabel) that leaves out the Manila time zone the first one sets
evidence: New today: `function dayLabel(value) { const date = new Date(value); return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? '' : date.toLocaleDateString('en-PH', { year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' }); }`. Already in the same file (line 265): `function formatLedgerDate(value) { ... return date.toLocaleDateString('en-PH', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric', timeZone: 'Asia/Manila' }); }`, and lib/format.js exports `manilaDate`. dayLabel is used for 'Advice from {date}' and 'The advice from {date} is out of date...'.
impact: Advice generated between midnight and 08:00 Manila time is labelled with the previous day for anyone whose browser is not on Manila time (advice_generated_at 2026-11-14T00:30+08:00 shows as 'Nov 13, 2026' on a UTC machine), while the ledger dates on the same page use Manila. Two helpers for one job in one file.
fix: Delete dayLabel and call the existing helper: `manilaDate(b.advice_generated_at)` from '../../../lib/format' (already imported for peso), or formatLedgerDate. Adjust FinancePage.test.jsx if it asserts the exact label.

title: Dead code left behind by today's changes: write-only $began in the chat stream, and urgencyRank with no caller
evidence: AskAiController::chat, lines 97-99: `$began = false; $emit = function (string $event, array $data) use (&$began): void { $began = true; $this->writeEvent($event, $data); };` and `$began` is never read (grep finds only these lines). client/src/pages/modules/grievances/grievanceLabels.js:25 `export function urgencyRank(urgency)` lost its only caller when SaoGrievancesPage moved sorting to the server (`-import { urgencyRank } from './grievanceLabels';`); `grep -rn urgencyRank client/src` now finds only the definition.
impact: No behaviour change. A reader of the stream closure looks for the branch that depends on whether an event was already sent (the catch block looks like it should) and finds none. CLAUDE.md Code Discipline asks for no leftovers.
fix: Remove `$began` and the `use (&$began)` capture (the closure becomes `fn (string $event, array $data) => $this->writeEvent($event, $data)`), or use it if the intent was to skip the generic error event once `meta` was sent. Delete urgencyRank from grievanceLabels.js.

title: Copy sweep: one shortened sentence lost the noun its pronoun points to ('Its own Admin')
evidence: `<Card title="People" description="Active members only. Its own Admin gives and removes access.">` Before today: 'Active members of this organization. Its own Admin gives and removes access.'
impact: A Department Head reading the People tab of an organization meets 'Its own Admin' with nothing in the card for 'Its' to refer to. Minor, and the only wording problem I found in the 32 approved sweep changes: every one was applied as approved, no rejected text was touched, and none left an empty wrapper, a dangling prop, an unused import or a removed warning (the fingerprint confirmation still says 'Only confirm when the Student's face and School ID match the person at the reader').
fix: Change the description to 'Active members only. The organization's Admin gives and removes access.'
